_README: EDITABLE TEMPLATE for the optional final-readout deck (UIOWA-088).
Fill this in against a real assessment report, then run:
The seven core sections are fixed and must appear once each in this order:
purpose, evidence, strengths, priority_findings, roadmap, resources, decisions.
Appendix slides carry the detail. Rules of the road, enforced by the checker:
- Any figure you say out loud is a claim with cites+measure+value+unit.
- A core slide stating a figure must name an appendix slide carrying the same id.
- A measure the report leaves UNKNOWN must be written as the string "UNKNOWN" here.
Do not substitute 0, 'n/a', or an estimate.
- Every high-priority gap in the report must appear on a core slide.
Claim types: strength | gap | figure | phase | resource | evidence | decision.
Delete this _README key in a real deck if you prefer; the checker ignores it.
